<thought>Analyzing the spectrum shows a classic carbon isotopic envelope: a series of peaks spaced ~1 Da with intensities decreasing roughly according to the binomial distribution for many ¹³C atoms (M+1 ≈ 20 % of M, M+2 ≈ 2 % of M, etc.). No significant M+2 peak characteristic of Cl, Br, or S is present, and the minor contributions from H, N, O are far below detection. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
